trends.name: Home underdogs
trends.desc: Bet every home team getting points.

trends.name: Big home underdogs (+7 or more)
trends.desc: Home teams getting 7+ points. The public loves big road favorites.

trends.name: Big road favorites (-7 or more)
trends.desc: Road teams laying 7+ points.

trends.name: Big home favorites (-10 or more)
trends.desc: Home teams laying double digits.

trends.name: Underdogs getting exactly +3
trends.desc: 3 is the most common NFL margin, so +3 has extra value.

trends.name: Division underdogs
trends.desc: Underdogs in division games. Familiar opponents keep games close.

trends.name: Division underdogs +7 or more
trends.desc: Big underdogs in division games.

trends.name: Home dogs, Week 13+
trends.desc: Home underdogs late in the season.

trends.name: Thursday night underdogs
trends.desc: Underdogs on Thursday night. Short week tends to compress games.

trends.name: Monday night home dogs
trends.desc: Home underdogs on Monday night.

trends.name: Teams off a bye
trends.desc: Team had 13+ days rest, opponent did not.

trends.name: Favorites off a bye
trends.desc: Favorite had 13+ days rest, opponent did not.

trends.name: Big rest advantage (3+ days)
trends.desc: Bet the team with 3+ more days of rest.

trends.name: West Coast teams at 1 PM ET
trends.desc: Pacific-time road teams playing a 1 PM ET game in the East (body clock at 10 AM).

trends.name: Off a 20+ point loss
trends.desc: Bet a team the week after it lost by 20+. Markets overreact to blowouts.

trends.name: Fade a team off a 20+ point win
trends.desc: Bet against a team the week after it won by 20+.

trends.name: Fade a team off an outright upset as a 7+ dog
trends.desc: Bet against a team the week after it won outright as a 7+ point underdog.

trends.name: Week 1 underdogs
trends.desc: Underdogs in Week 1.

trends.name: Primetime unders
trends.desc: Unders in Thursday, Sunday and Monday night games. The public bets overs in big games.

trends.name: Thursday night unders
trends.desc: Unders on Thursday night.

trends.name: Monday night unders
trends.desc: Unders on Monday night.

trends.name: Sunday night unders
trends.desc: Unders in Sunday night games.

trends.name: Division game unders
trends.desc: Unders when division rivals meet.

trends.name: Division rematch unders
trends.desc: Unders in the second meeting of division rivals.

trends.name: Wind 15+ mph unders
trends.desc: Unders in outdoor games with 15+ mph wind (needs a game-day forecast).

trends.name: Freezing games (32F or colder) unders
trends.desc: Unders in outdoor games at or below freezing.

trends.name: High totals (50+) unders
trends.desc: Unders when the total is 50 or higher.

trends.name: Low totals (38 or less) overs
trends.desc: Overs when the total is 38 or lower.

trends.name: Dome game overs
trends.desc: Overs in dome or closed-roof games.

trends.name: Unders, Week 13+
trends.desc: Unders late in the season.

trends.name: Playoff unders
trends.desc: Unders in the playoffs.

trends.name: Wong teaser: favorites -7.5 to -8.5
trends.desc: Tease favorites of -7.5 to -8.5 down 6 points through 7 and 3 (to -1.5 to -2.5). Each leg must win 73.9% to profit.

trends.name: Wong teaser: underdogs +1.5 to +2.5
trends.desc: Tease underdogs of +1.5 to +2.5 up 6 points through 3 and 7 (to +7.5 to +8.5).

trends.name: Wong teaser dogs, total under 49
trends.desc: Wong underdog legs only when the total is under 49 (fewer points makes 7 and 3 matter more).
